Job Purpose
As a Supply Chain Solutions Specialist, you will build and manage customized supply chain solutions enabling client delivery across a range of localization and/or data services projects, as well as support some of the more demanding solutions. This includes, but is not limited to onboarding and qualification, financials, risk, compliance, contracting, reporting and supplier performance management.
You will be expected to take ownership and lead assigned business area or initiative(s), ensuring their performance and/or progress meet expectations.
About LXD
Did you know that more than 7,000 languages are spoken around the world? Language defines the art of communication. It is how we connect with friends and family, and how we ultimately unlock understanding. The LXD offers clients access to the world’s largest linguistic network, including more than 1,600 in-house translators and in excess of 29,000 freelance specialists, whose cultural and technical expertise underpin 24/7 service provision in over 80 countries.
Job Overview
Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a supply chain specialist, providing solutions to internal teams supporting client delivery.

• Analyze current and future requirements for assigned accounts and design, build, and/or manage customized supply chain solutions using the existing database of global partners and the AI Community.

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure all relevant information is accurate and up to date.

• Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers supporting assigned programs.

• Provide ongoing support to suppliers regarding client-specific requirements, processes, and issue resolution.

• Proactively identify risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement within workflows and processes.

• Manage and monitor supplier performance for assigned accounts.

Skills & Experience

• 3+ years of experience in supply chain management, vendor management, project management, or a similar role, preferably within the localization and/or data services industry.

• Ability to take ownership of responsibilities and manage tasks independently, while seeking guidance when needed.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a collaborative and positive approach.

• Process-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving results.

• Fluency in English, both spoken and written.

• Advanced proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint), including functions such as VLOOKUP.

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Proven ability to work with data, perform analysis, and present actionable insights, recommendations, and reports.

Life at RWS
Life at RWS - If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about breaking down language barriers and giving back to their communities, then you’ll love life at RWS.

RWS embraces DEI and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
• 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

• 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer
• 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• 
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
This is a contracting role that is fully remote.

About Semaphore

Semaphore is a remote-first software company building continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) products for engineering teams. Our customers rely on Semaphore Cloud and our self-hosted enterprise products to build, test, and deliver software securely and reliably.

We have spent years building developer infrastructure at scale. We are now using that foundation to create new products and capabilities for a world in which software is increasingly built by people working with AI coding agents.

About the role

We are looking for a senior product engineer who can take an important idea from an early, ambiguous problem to a useful product running in production.

You will work across product and engineering boundaries: understanding the user, shaping the solution, making technical decisions, building the system, and improving it based on real use. Some work will extend mature Semaphore products. Some will start as a small experiment or a new product. In either case, you will be responsible for getting to a strong outcome, not completing a predefined list of tickets.

AI coding agents are part of our daily engineering workflow. We expect you to use them fluently to explore, build, test, and ship faster. You remain accountable for the work: choosing the right problem, setting direction, making trade-offs, reviewing what is produced, and ensuring that the result is coherent, reliable, and maintainable.

This role is for someone with strong ownership, initiative, taste, and judgment. You should be comfortable moving between product questions, system design, code, infrastructure, and user experience as the work requires.

What you will own

• Take product ideas from problem definition through design, implementation, rollout, and iteration, including experiments that may grow into standalone products.

• Work directly with users and internal stakeholders to identify the real problem, decide what is worth building, and make pragmatic scope and architecture decisions.

• Build across backend services, APIs, infrastructure-facing components, and focused frontend experiences, reusing proven Semaphore systems before introducing new infrastructure.

• Use AI coding agents effectively while maintaining a high bar for correctness, security, clarity, and product quality.

• Own the production outcome, including reliability, observability, supportability, and working within Semaphore's security and compliance requirements. Communicate decisions, progress, and risks clearly.

What we are looking for

• A track record of independently shipping meaningful software products or major product capabilities.

• Strong product judgment: you can identify the essential user problem, reduce unnecessary scope, and recognize when an experience is good enough to ship—or not good enough yet.

• Strong engineering judgment across system design, implementation, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

• Strong backend and systems fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous processing, service boundaries, state and lifecycle management, retries, idempotency, and failure recovery.

• Comfort with infrastructure concepts such as virtual machines, storage, networking, authentication, secrets, containers, and cloud platforms.

• Ability to navigate a polyglot environment. Semaphore systems include Go, Elixir, Ruby, React, and related technologies; expertise in every language is not required.

• Enough frontend capability to build or extend focused product user experiences without depending on a separate team for every change.

• Fluency with modern AI-assisted development: decomposing work for agents, supplying useful context, reviewing generated changes, and building verification into the workflow.
Initiative and persistence. You make progress with incomplete information, surface risks early, and bring in other people when their input will improve the result.

• Strong written and spoken English and experience working independently in a remote, asynchronous team.

We care more about the quality and ownership of what you have built than a specific number of years, previous title, or exact match with our stack.

Nice to have

• Experience building developer tools, CI/CD systems, cloud platforms, or infrastructure products.

• Hands-on experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures.

• Experience evolving a mature codebase while introducing a new product or architecture alongside it.

• Experience in a lean environment where senior engineers participate directly in product discovery and customer conversations.

What success looks like

Within your first three months:

• You have taken ownership of a meaningful product problem and shipped a useful capability to production.

• Your work shows good product taste, clear technical decisions, and disciplined scope.

• You have learned enough of Semaphore's existing platform to reuse its strengths and avoid unnecessary reinvention.

• You are using AI coding agents to increase your output while keeping the resulting systems understandable, tested, and reliable.

• Product and engineering decisions move faster because you bring clear options, make sound calls, and follow through.

• The team trusts you with an ambiguous new product or feature and expects you to drive it to a strong result.

How you will work

This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad ownership. You will work closely with engineering, product, infrastructure, and company leadership. Teams are small, communication is direct, and the person closest to the work is expected to exercise judgment.

You will have room to shape both the product and its implementation. In return, we expect you to take responsibility for the whole outcome: what gets built, why it matters, how well it works, and what happens after it ships.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/semaphore-senior-product-engineer

f7a41eb64780a872.description: ## About Metaforms Metaforms is redefining how market research gets done. You'll own research quality end-to-end at Metaforms: designing and reviewing questionnaires, sense-checking data, and building reports that hold up to client scrutiny. You'll also be the research conscience for our product and engineering teams — making sure the AI we build actually reflects how good research gets done, not a shortcut version of it. ## What You'll Do - Design questionnaires from a brief: objectives, sampling plan, screener logic, scale choice, routing — the full craft, not just clean-up - Review and QA questionnaires and data for methodological soundness (bias, leading questions, sampling issues, logic errors) - Strong grounding in questionnaire design, sampling, and methodology - Can independently write an insights report that tells a story, not just describe charts - Sharp eye for what's wrong with a survey or a dataset - Comfortable being the person who says "this isn't good research" to a client or a product team **Bonus** - Experience working alongside survey programmers / DP teams - Hands-on with Excel, PowerPoint, and a BI/viz tool (Tableau, Power BI, Displayr, [Crunch.io](http://Crunch.io)) - Curiosity about how AI changes research ops — not required to be technical, just not allergic to it ## Why Join Metaforms - Work at the frontier of AI-powered market research - Your research judgment directly shapes the product, not just a project - Zero-bureaucracy culture — speed, quality, customer impact - Series A funded, scaling fast ## Benefits - Full family health insurance - $1,000 USD/year for skill development - Dedicated mentor/coach support - Free lunch & dinner at office - Monthly food/snacks allowance
